state.case: Operation X has an edition-window admission. The target criterion handler reads the gate as open and the target stream as empty, then pauses before appending. Coordinator times out and marks X refused without recording any event on the target. Gate seals and publication completes. The paused handler resumes and attempts its already-prepared append against the still-empty target stream. No other events have been appended to that target.

append_can_win.instructions: In this case, can the paused handler append its prepared criterion event after publication if the target stream version is still unchanged?

fence_changes_version.instructions: In this case, would a committed token-specific fence on the target before gate closure cause the paused append with its original expected stream version to conflict?
